items.summary: U.S. captain Angela Stanford has unveiled the 12-woman team that will take on Europe in The Netherlands next month in the 20th edition of the Solheim Cup. The nine automatic qualifying spots have gone to world No 1 Nelly Korda along with Lauren Coughlin (world No 18), Auston Kim (22), Angel Yin (25), Jennifer Kupcho (31), Yealimi Noh (39), Andrea Lee (40), Allisen Corpuz (45) and Alison Lee (55).
